summaries.title: Beyond Scaling Laws: Understanding Transformer Performance with Associative Memory
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**模型架构与序列建模**（Architecture）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」痛点，作者围绕 **Beyond Scaling Laws** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖尺度定律（Scaling Law）。核心论点主张：We present a theoretical framework that sheds light on the memorization process and performance dynamics of transformer-based language models。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **2M tokens**。实验设计与验证细节：We substantiate our theoretical results by conducting experiments with GPT-2 on various data sizes, as well as training vanilla Transformers on a dataset of 2M...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Under specific conditions, we show that the minimum achievable cross-entropy loss is bounded from below by a constant approximately equal to 1）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 34 赞），本工作为突破 **模型架构与序列建模** 中的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Coin3D: Controllable and Interactive 3D Assets Generation with Proxy-Guided Conditioning
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **Coin3D** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖扩散模型（Diffusion Model）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we present a novel controllable and interactive 3D assets modeling framework, named Coin3D。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：However, similar workflows in 3D modeling tasks are still unavailable due to the lack of controllability and efficiency in 3D generation。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive experiments of interactive generation and editing on diverse shape proxies demonstrate that our method achieves superior controllability and flexibility in the 3D assets...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 25 赞），本工作为突破 **3D高斯泼溅与资产绑定 (3DGS & Rigging)** 中的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We therefore develop SpeechVerse, a robust multi-task training and curriculum learning framework that combines pre-trained speech and text foundation...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our empirical experiments reveal that our multi-task SpeechVerse model is even superior to conventional task-specific baselines on 9 out of the 11 tasks）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 19 赞），本工作为突破 **多模态与统一基座** 中的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Understanding the performance gap between online and offline alignment algorithms

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐、受控干预消融与多范式系统对比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Within the context of reward over-optimization, we start with an opening set of experiments that demonstrate the clear advantage of online methods...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We also find that while offline algorithms train policy to become good at pairwise classification, it is worse at generations; in the meantime the policies trained by online algorithms...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 18 赞），本工作为突破 **人类反馈与偏好优化 (RLHF/DPO)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Compositional Text-to-Image Generation with Dense Blob Representations
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Compositional Text-to-Image Generation with Dense** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、扩散模型（Diffusion Model）、上下文学习（In-Context Learning (ICL)）。核心论点主张：In this work, we propose to decompose a scene into visual primitives - denoted as dense blob representations - that contain fine-grained details of the scene while being...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **MS-COCO**。实验设计与验证细节：Based on blob representations, we develop a blob-grounded text-to-image diffusion model, termed BlobGEN, for compositional generation。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our extensive experiments show that BlobGEN achieves superior zero-shot generation quality and better layout-guided controllability on MS-COCO）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 17 赞），本工作为突破 **图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In this paper, we propose to squeeze the time axis of a video sequence into the channel dimension and present a lightweight video recognition...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **+1.2%, +80%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（For example, our SqueezeTime achieves +1.2% accuracy and +80% GPU throughput gain on Kinetics400 than prior methods）。

summaries.title: SpeechGuard: Exploring the Adversarial Robustness of Multimodal Large Language Models

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Despite safety guardrails, experiments on jailbreaking demonstrate the vulnerability of SLMs to adversarial perturbations and transfer attacks, with average attack...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **80%, 90%, 10%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our models, trained on dialog data with speech instructions, achieve state-of-the-art performance on spoken...；However, we demonstrate that our proposed countermeasures reduce the attack success significantly）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 13 赞），本工作为突破 **原生全模态与语音交互 (Omni & Audio)、越狱攻防与智能体护栏 (Red-Team & Guardrails)** 中的「安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
